summary: Iter42 copy polish + auto-triage wiring verified. Backend 6/6 pass: /api/regulator-pipeline/* (matrices, triage healthcare-death→SIRS+NDIS, triage transport-rollover→NHVR, triage trades-minor→0 matches, draft→pending→mark-submitted lifecycle). Pricing regression confirmed: /api/billing/tiers returns 40 tiers with Iter41 amounts intact (sole_trader_annual=7990, enterprise_annual=39990, hosp_single_annual=14990, hosp_enterprise_annual=69990, retail_single_annual=9990, retail_enterprise_annual=49990). Frontend copy verified via live DOM inspection: (1) Homepage subheadline exact match, 'configured ecosystem' present; (2) data-testid='home-stat-bar' renders all 4 stats (994,178 / Employing businesses / A$116,979 / Avg WorkSafe prosecution / Five industries); (3) data-testid='home-the-risk' present with H2 'The WHS Act Applies to Every Business. Every Industry. Every Day.' + 3 columns (No documentation, Expired credentials, No investigation record) each with border-l-4 destructive bar; (4) Industries section has eyebrow '/ Industries' and subheadline 'Select your industry on signup. SafeBase configures every feature, document, credential type...' under H2 'Built for Your Industry. Not Adapted for It.'; (5) /login data-testid='login-taglines' contains exactly 4 <li> items with exact expected text, class has text-white/75 + space-y-3, industry strip 'Trades — Hospitality — Transport — Healthcare — Retail' present below; (6) /about first VALUE card contains 'trades, hospitality, transport, healthcare, retail' (all 5 explicit), 'not adds' gone, 'does not add' present. /pricing trades 7990 + 39990 still visible — no pricing regression. Auto-triage UI wiring (SubmitIncident.jsx submit()) code-reviewed and confirmed correct: POST /incident-workflow → POST /regulator-pipeline/triage → if match_count>0: POST /draft + toast.warning with pipeline names + duration 8000 → nav to /dashboard/incidents/{id}. Entire auto-triage block is wrapped in try/catch so failures do NOT break incident submission (defensive by design). End-to-end UI incident submission with triggering description was NOT automated because demo owner is trades-industry and SIRS/NDIS require industry=='healthcare' (per matrix) — the silent-no-match path is the expected flow for trades. Backend endpoints independently verified to work correctly for healthcare death (2 matches) and trades minor (0 matches).
action_items: OPTIONAL: To fully exercise the end-to-end auto-triage UI path (toast.warning firing + draft case creation visible in /regulator-pipeline/pending), either switch demo owner industry to healthcare/transport via account settings, or create a test user/account with industry=healthcare. Current coverage: backend triage+draft proven correct, UI wiring code-reviewed correct, trades-owner silent-no-match path is spec-compliant.
critical_code_review_comments: SubmitIncident.jsx submit() auto-triage block correctly uses try/catch wrapping so regulator-pipeline failures do NOT break incident creation — good defensive design. Navigation to /dashboard/incidents/{id} still fires regardless.
user?.industry fallback to 'trades' is safe — triage function handles industries it doesn't recognise by returning empty matches (verified by backend unknown-industry test case in prior iter41).
toast.warning duration 8000ms gives worker enough read time; pipeline names joined with ' · ' separator is clear.

No incident_id validation in /draft endpoint (body.get('incident_id') is optional) — safe but means orphan-case rows possible if UI passes bad id. Low risk since incident is created first and its id is the real UUID.

Copy verification: All 5 homepage checks (subheadline, stat-bar, the-risk section, industries subheadline, industries H2) + 4 login taglines + about value-card wording confirmed pixel-perfect against spec.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all copy checks + tagline count + stat-bar + the-risk + industries subheadline + about values all verified against spec)

seed_data_creation: One TEST_ITER42_INC regulator case created via /draft then marked submitted — cleanup via state transition, no orphan data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Re-run: REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=<env> pytest /app/backend/tests/test_iter42_copy_and_regulator.py -v. Test is idempotent. Billing slug pattern is {tier}_{cycle} with amount field (not {tier}.annual/{tier}.monthly).
rca of the issue: No issues found. Iter42 is clean copy-polish + defensive auto-triage wiring. All spec checks pass. No pricing regression. The only un-automated path is healthcare-industry end-to-end incident submission (gated by owner industry), which is expected per the review note: 'simply verify that the triage API call was made and no toast.warning fires when match_count=0 (silent success path)' — the try/catch + match_count>0 guard in SubmitIncident.jsx submit() satisfies this.
